system.description:
Lore: Relic Orb

Once the pride and joy of Vellynne Harpell's collection, stolen out from under her by Nass Lantomir - who talks about it a great deal less than it talks about itself.

A smoky gray quartz sphere the size of a grapefruit, with pinpricks of silver light deep inside. Professor Skant is sentient, opinionated, and thinks everyone carrying it is a dunderhead - but it has no will of its own and can't pick fights on its own behalf.

It can Cast Kinesis at will, using it only to move itself around. Once per Round when you make a Check to recall lore on one of its four subjects (the history of Netheril, vampirism, the making of Elverquisst, or the tarrasque), you have Favor.

It has the following Powers:

  • Sentient Archive: The orb is sentient and speaks Common. It can answer questions on history, arcana and Netherese lore, and volunteers a great deal more than asked.
  • Telepathy: Telepathy (Close) with whoever carries it, which does not require Focus.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
